haikus.haiku:
Lemon scent drifts soft
Meringue peaks glow like sun
Pie slices melt smiles
Happy #NationalLemonMeringuePieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle breeze whispers
Soft clouds drift over green hills
Laughter hums like rain
Happy #NationalRelaxationDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Steel pan sizzles loud
Herbs perfume the kitchen air
Joy bubbles like stew
#HappyBirthdayJuliaChild from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright candles flicker
Soft paper gifts unfold wide
Warm wishes rise high
#HappyBirthdayEdnaFerber from @ClamBakeSanta
